decisive_items: extraskeletal myxoid chondrosarcoma of the left foot treated 9 years earlier
a mass arising from the right frontal diploic space with intracranial extension
Noncontrast head CT revealed a lytic lesion of the right frontal bone
response.rationale: History of extraskeletal myxoid chondrosarcoma with a new lytic calvarial mass causing intracranial extension is most consistent with late metastasis of that sarcoma, rather than a primary soft-tissue or bone tumor.

rejected.why: Dermatofibrosarcoma protuberans is a cutaneous soft-tissue sarcoma and does not explain a diploic-space origin, lytic bone destruction, or intracranial extension in a patient with known EMC.
Osteosarcoma could produce a lytic calvarial lesion with soft-tissue extension, but the strong prior history of EMC and absence of other primary osteosarcoma features make metastasis more likely.
